model.title: A bill to permit visiting dignitaries and service members from Taiwan to display the flag of the Republic of China.
model.meta: Foreign Relations Committee · Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would allow visiting government officials and military personnel from Taiwan to display the Republic of China flag while in the United States. This measure aims to permit such flag displays at official events and venues during their visits.
